title: Install Docker and Run Hello‑World
description: Set up Docker on your machine, verify the installation, and run your first container.
problemStatement:
## Objective
Install Docker Desktop (or Docker Engine on Linux) and successfully run the `hello-world` container.

### Steps
1. Download and install Docker Desktop from [docker.com](https://docker.com) (or use your Linux package manager).
2. Start Docker and wait until the whale icon stops animating.
3. Open a terminal and run:
   ```bash
   docker version
   ```
   Confirm that both **Client** and **Server** sections appear.
4. Run:
   ```bash
   docker run hello-world
   ```
5. Observe the output. You should see `Hello from Docker!` and a congratulations message.

### Deliverable
Take a screenshot or copy the terminal output showing the successful run.
hints: If you see a 'daemon not running' error, make sure Docker Desktop is running (check the system tray).
On Linux, if you get a permission denied error, add your user to the `docker` group (`sudo usermod -aG docker $USER`) and log out/in.
expectedOutput:
Hello from Docker!
This message shows that your installation appears to be working correctly.
